name: claudewatch
description: Cross-platform Electron app to monitor Claude Code CLI instances

scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run build:widget && npm run changelog && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run changelog && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run changelog && electron-builder --linux
scripts.publish:local: npm run build && npm run build:widget && npm run clean:dist-temp && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=true node scripts/build-mac.js
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run publish:local
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run publish:local
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run publish:local
scripts.build:office-web: vite build --config vite.office-server.config.ts && vite build --config vite.office-web.config.ts && node scripts/sync-office-to-framework.mjs out/office-web

author: Angelo
